{"command":"cd /workspace/scratch/c0f3ec78c621/validation/audit-20261117/itbench-aa-r2/case-005/workspace && python - <<'PY'
import pandas as pd,collections
D=pd.read_csv('otel_traces_raw.tsv',sep='\t',usecols=['Timestamp','TraceId','ParentSpanId','SpanName','ServiceName','StatusCode','StatusMessage','SpanAttributes'])
E=D[D.StatusCode.eq('Error')].copy(); print('error by service',E.ServiceName.value_counts().to_dict())
for svc in ['frontend','frontend-proxy','ad','fraud-detection','flagd','cart','recommendation']:
 g=E[E.ServiceName.eq(svc)]
 print('\n##',svc)
 groups=collections.defaultdict(list)
 for _,r in g.iterrows():
  a=str(r.SpanAttributes)
  # get only diagnostic attributes from raw representation
  err=''
  for key in ('grpc.error_message','error.message','http.status_code','error.type','net.peer.name','rpc.grpc.status_code','server.address'):
   token="'"+key+"': "
   p=a.find(token)
   if p>=0: err+=key+'='+a[p+len(token):].split(',',1)[0]+';'
  groups[(r.SpanName,err,str(r.StatusMessage)[:90])].append(r.Timestamp)
 for k,ts in sorted(groups.items(),key=lambda x:-len(x[1]))[:10]: print(len(ts),min(ts),max(ts),k)
PY","timeout":120}
